units.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript reads and writes 3D scenes using the Scene class, supporting formats such as OBJ, STL, GLTF, and U3D through its fromFile, openFromBuffer, save, and saveToBuffer methods. It constructs and manipulates scene graphs with Node, Entity, Mesh, Material, Camera, and Light objects, and supports materials like LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, and PbrMaterial with texture access via getTexture and setTexture. It handles geometry with VertexElementUV, VertexElementNormal, and VertexElementVertexColor, and provides utilities for triangulation, bounding boxes, and coordinate transformations using PolygonModifier.triangulate, BoundingBox, FVector3, FMatrix4, and MathUtils. It supports animation with AnimationClip, AnimationNode, AnimationChannel, KeyframeSequence, and KeyFrame, and exposes property management through A3DObject.findProperty, getProperty, and setProperty.
Build and traverse a hierarchical scene graph with Scene and Node — every node holds a Transform, an optional entity (Mesh, Camera, or Light), and child nodes accessible via childNodes.

Construct mesh geometry with Mesh.controlPoints and createPolygon, and attach per-vertex attribute channels — normals (VertexElementNormal), UVs (VertexElementUV), and vertex color (VertexElementVertexColor) — through the VertexElement hierarchy.

Assign shading materials through Material subclasses — LambertMaterial (diffuse-only), PhongMaterial (adds specular/shininess), and PbrMaterial (metallic/roughness, mapping directly to the glTF PBR model).
Place Camera (projection type, field of view, clip distances) and Light (POINT, DIRECTIONAL, SPOT, AREA, VOLUME) entities as scene nodes.

Animate node properties with keyframes — AnimationClip groups AnimationNode tracks, each holding AnimationChannel s of KeyframeSequence time/value samples with configurable Interpolation/Extrapolation.

Read glTF (JSON and binary GLB) and Wavefront OBJ scenes, and write STL (ASCII and binary), FBX (ASCII), COLLADA (.dae, via xmldom), and glTF JSON scenes through Scene.open()/Scene.openFromBuffer() and Scene.save() — OBJ export and binary GLB export both carry real, current defects; see Scope and Limitations before relying on either.
Perform 3D math operations using FVector3, FMatrix4, Quaternion, and MathUtils, and compute bounding volumes with BoundingBox.
Inspect and modify object properties through Property and PropertyCollection, and access them via A3DObject.findProperty, A3DObject.getProperty, and A3DObject.setProperty.

The @aspose/3d package provides 3D scene manipulation capabilities in TypeScript. The Scene class serves as the primary entry point, offering static and instance methods to load, save, and manage 3D content.

The Scene class loads files or buffers via Scene.fromFile, Scene.open, or Scene.openFromBuffer, and writes output using Scene.save or Scene.saveToBuffer, exposing the node hierarchy through its rootNode property.

The Node class represents an element in the scene graph, supporting child nodes via addChildNode and childNodes, attaching entities with addEntity and entities, and computing world-space transforms through globalTransform.
The Mesh class defines polygonal geometry using controlPoints and supports polygon creation via createPolygon, with triangulate converting all polygons to triangles for export.
The AnimationClip class holds animation data through animations and creates animation tracks via createAnimationNode.
The FileFormat class identifies supported formats using getFormatByExtension and determines import or export capability via canImport and canExport.
The Quaternion class represents rotations using slerp for interpolation, fromEulerAngle for construction from Euler angles, and toString for string representation.
The BoundingBox class defines an axis-aligned volume using minimum and maximum corners, with contains checking whether points lie inside.
The Property class stores typed name/value pairs with name, value, and valueType properties for metadata attached to scene objects.
The VertexElementUV class stores 2D texture coordinates with uvData and mappingMode for mapping texture coordinates onto geometry.
The Material class manages surface appearance with getTexture and setTexture for texture assignment.
The Camera class defines view parameters with fieldOfView and projectionType for perspective or orthographic projection.
The Light class specifies illumination with lightType and direction for directional, point, or spot lighting.
It adds rendering, additional exchange formats, and full production feature completeness.
A3DObject class provides named objects with a collection of properties and methods to manage them.
AnimationChannel class holds animation data with a keyframe sequence, a bind point, and a default value.
AnimationClip class groups animation nodes and provides a description and name for the clip.
AnimationNode class manages bind points and keyframe sequences for animation.
ApertureMode enum lists the HORIZONTAL, HORZ_AND_VERT and VERTICAL aperture modes.
AssetInfo class provides named objects with a collection of properties and methods to manage them.
BindPoint class holds animation channels and provides methods to manage them.
BooleanOperation enum lists the ADD, INTERSECT and SUB boolean operations.
BoundingBox class represents a 3D bounding box with minimum and maximum points and an extent.
BoundingBox2D class represents a 2D bounding box with minimum and maximum points and an extent.
BoundingBoxExtent class defines the size of a bounding box in X, Y and Z directions.
Camera class provides apertureMode, aspect, aspectRatio, direction and excluded properties, but Camera.getEntityRendererKey throws Error.
ComposeOrder enum lists the APPEND and PREPEND compose orders.
CustomObject class provides named objects with a collection of properties and methods to manage them.
Entity class provides excluded, name and parentNode properties, but Entity.getBoundingBox and Entity.getEntityRendererKey throw Error.
Extrapolation class holds extrapolation type and repeat count for animation.
ExtrapolationType enum lists the CONSTANT, CYCLE, CYCLE_RELATIVE, GRADIENT and OSCILLATE extrapolation types.
FMatrix4 class provides matrix operations, but FMatrix4.inverse throws Error (conditionally).
FVector2 class provides 2D vector operations, but FVector2.add, FVector2.div, FVector2.parse and FVector2.sub throw errors (conditionally).
FVector3 class provides 3D vector operations, but FVector3.getItem and FVector3.setItem throw Error (conditionally).
FVector4 class provides 4D vector operations, but FVector4.getItem and FVector4.setItem throw Error (conditionally).
FileFormat class provides file format capabilities including import, export, and extension support.

FileSystem class provides file system operations, but FileSystem.createDummyFileSystem, FileSystem.createLocalFileSystem, FileSystem.createZipFileSystem, FileSystem.readFile and FileSystem.writeFile throw Error.

Geometry class provides control points and element management, but Geometry.findProperty, Geometry.getProperty and Geometry.getEntityRendererKey always return null or false, and Geometry.getEntityRendererKey throws Error.
GlobalTransform class provides transform components including rotation, scale, translation and Euler angles.
IIndexedVertexElement class provides vertex indices for geometry elements.
INamedObject interface provides a name property for named objects.
IOExtension class provides input and output extension capabilities.
ImageRenderOptions class provides width and height settings for image rendering.
Interpolation enum lists the BEZIER, B_SPLINE, CARDINAL_SPLINE, CONSTANT, LINEAR and TCB_SPLINE interpolation types.
KeyFrame class provides keyframe data including interpolation, bias, continuity and tangent information.
KeyframeSequence class holds a collection of keyframes and provides a name and post behavior.
LambertMaterial class provides Lambert material properties including ambient and diffuse colors, but LambertMaterial.getTexture always returns null.
Light class provides apertureMode, aspect, aspectRatio, direction and excluded properties, but Light.getEntityRendererKey throws Error.
LightType enum lists the AREA, DIRECTIONAL, POINT, SPOT and VOLUME light types.
MappingMode enum lists the ALL_SAME, CONTROL_POINT, EDGE, POLYGON and POLYGON_VERTEX mapping modes.
Material class provides material properties, but Material.getTexture always returns null.
MathUtils class provides mathematical utilities including normal calculation, intersection tests and angle conversions.
Matrix4 class provides matrix operations, but Matrix4.inverse throws Error (conditionally).
Mesh class provides control points and element management, but Mesh.difference, Mesh.doBoolean, Mesh.getEntityRendererKey, Mesh.intersect, Mesh.isManifold and Mesh.optimize throw Error.
Node class provides node hierarchy management with methods to add child nodes and entities, and to access child nodes and entities.
ParseException class is the exception type for parsing errors.
PbrMaterial class defines physically based rendering material properties including albedo, albedo texture, and texture maps for ambient, diffuse, emissive, normal, and specular channels.
PhongMaterial class defines Phong shading material properties including ambient color, diffuse color, and texture maps for ambient, diffuse, emissive, normal, and specular channels.
PolygonModifier class provides a triangulate method that is not implemented.
ProjectionType enum lists the ORTHOGRAPHIC and PERSPECTIVE projection types.
Property class holds a name, value, value type, and extra data for scene properties.
PropertyCollection class provides a collection of properties with methods to find, get, remove, and enumerate properties.
Quaternion class provides quaternion operations including identity, concatenation, conjugation, dot product, equality, Euler angles, and angle-axis construction.
Rect class represents a rectangle with left, top, right, bottom, width, and height properties and a contains method.
ReferenceMode enum lists the DIRECT, INDEX, and INDEX_TO_DIRECT reference modes.
RelativeRectangle class represents a rectangle with offset and scale properties for relative positioning.
RotationMode enum lists the FIXED and ORBIT rotation modes.
RotationOrder enum lists the XYZ, XZY, YXZ, YZX, ZXY, and ZYX rotation orders.
Scene class provides scene management with animation clips, asset info, clearing, and property access; open, render, and save methods are not implemented.
SceneObject class provides a name, scene reference, and property collection for scene objects.
SemanticAttribute class provides a semantic and alias for vertex attributes.
SplitMeshPolicy enum lists the ADJUST and CLONE_DATA split mesh policies.
StepMode enum lists the NEXT_VALUE and PREVIOUS_VALUE step modes.
TextureMapping enum lists the AMBIENT, BUMP, DIFFUSE, DISPLACEMENT, EMISSIVE, GLOW, NORMAL, and OPACITY texture mapping types.
Transform class provides transformation properties including Euler angles, geometric rotation, scaling, translation, and property access.
TransformBuilder class provides methods to build transforms using append, compose, prepend, and rearrange operations.
Vector2 class provides a two-component vector with constructor, equality, length, parsing, and indexed access; getItem, setItem, and parse are not implemented.
Vector3 class provides a three-component vector with constructor, angle between, comparison, cosine, cross product, dot product, and equality; getItem, parse, and setItem are not implemented.
Vector4 class provides a four-component vector with constructor, equality, indexed access, string conversion, and w and x components; getItem and setItem are not implemented.
Vertex class provides vertex data reading with methods for double, float, and vector types; readDouble, readFloat, readFVector2, readFVector3, readFVector4, and readVector2 are not implemented.
VertexDeclaration class provides vertex declaration management with field addition, clearing, comparison, and geometry conversion; addField, clear, and fromGeometry are not implemented.
VertexElement class provides vertex element properties including indices, mapping mode, name, reference mode, and type; clear, indices, and setIndices are not implemented.
VertexElementFVector class provides floating-point vector element data with copy, data, indices, mapping mode, name, and reference mode; setData is not implemented.
VertexElementIntsTemplate class provides integer element data with copy, data, indices, mapping mode, name, and reference mode.
VertexElementNormal class provides normal element data with copy, data, indices, mapping mode, name, and reference mode; setData is not implemented.
VertexElementSmoothingGroup class provides smoothing group element data with copy, data, indices, mapping mode, name, and reference mode.
VertexElementTangent class provides tangent element data with copy, data, indices, mapping mode, name, and reference mode; setData is not implemented.
VertexElementType enum lists the BINORMAL, EDGE_CREASE, HOLE, MATERIAL, NORMAL, POLYGON_GROUP, SMOOTHING_GROUP, and SPECIFIC types.
VertexElementUV class provides UV element data with add data, copy, data, indices, mapping mode, and name; addData and setData are not implemented.
VertexElementVertexColor class provides vertex color element data with copy, data, indices, mapping mode, name, and reference mode; setData is not implemented.
VertexField class provides vertex field properties including alias, data type, index, offset, semantic, and size.
VertexFieldDataType enum lists the BYTE_VECTOR4, DOUBLE, FLOAT, F_VECTOR2, F_VECTOR3, F_VECTOR4, INT16, and INT32 data types.
VertexFieldSemantic enum lists the BINORMAL, EDGE_CREASE, MORPH_NORMAL, MORPH_POSITION, NORMAL, POSITION, SPECULAR, and TANGENT semantics.
Watermark class provides watermark encoding and decoding; decodeWatermark and encodeWatermark are not implemented.
WeightedMode enum lists the BOTH, NEXT_IN_WEIGHT, NONE, and OUT_WEIGHT weighted mode values.
